name: mirasim-computer-use
description: Drive browsers, macOS apps and Electron apps through their accessibility trees: one call runs a chain of steps and reports each one.

browser.title: Browser
browser.description: managed: a Chrome of its own, logins kept between sessions. extension: the Chrome you are signed into, through the Mirasim extension (install it from the Chrome Web Store first).

platforms.title: What it may drive
platforms.description: browser, plus macos (native macOS apps; grant Accessibility to the app that runs Claude Code) and electron (an app started with --remote-debugging-port=9333).
